content: getSession() reads the cookie/localStorage value without verifying the JWT signature against the Auth server -- spoofable, never trust it for server-side authorization. getUser() round-trips to Supabase Auth to validate the token, which is the required call in middleware/Server Components/Route Handlers despite the extra latency. Newer getClaims() can verify locally (asymmetric JWT keys, WebCrypto) without a network call, but requires the project to be on asymmetric signing keys -- not assumed present here, so getUser() remains the safe default for this phase.
